## Explanations

### The daily routine

Each of the 365 simulated days follows the same seven phases: morning feed 6:30 AM (40% of the day's ration), morning cleaning after it, the 9:00 AM duties round (vet work in each building's vet area), lifecycle events, afternoon feed 1:30 PM (20%), night feed 7:30 PM (40%) and night cleaning. Every occupied building is cleaned twice a day and each cleaning is verified by the cleaner manager.

### One building per bucket, each with a vet area

The ten lifecycle buckets are modelled as ten buildings using the seeded goat names (Quarantine Ward, Foundation / Grow-out, …). The vet's round is routed building by building; the busiest vet area this run: Quarantine Ward. Building-days of occupancy: Breeding Bucket 321, Delivery Ward 15, Foundation / Grow-out 139, Pregnancy A 123, Pregnancy B 64, Quarantine Ward 44, Recovery Ward 32, Resting / Dry-off + Flush 47.

### Feed mixed once, delivered three times

Each morning the day's ration per recipe is mixed at the feed store and then delivered per building in the 40/20/40 shift split (6:30 AM / 1:30 PM 7:30 PM). Per-head rates are the seeded bucket defaults (kids 1.0 kg, does 1.2 kg, late pregnancy 1.4 kg, delivery/recovery 1.5 kg, quarantine 1.1 kg); unweaned kids in RECOVERY are fed the creep line at 0.3 kg, never the doe's lactating TMR.

### Every move is a legal lifecycle transition

277 moves were executed, each validated against the same legal bucket graph the live app enforces (models.lifecycle.LEGAL_BUCKET_TRANSITIONS) and stamped with the workflow context that caused it — manual, ultrasound, delivery, kidding, weaning, orphan weaning, quarantine release, abortion, postpartum or breeding.

### Reproduction: breed → scan +32d → kidding +150d

59 services were recorded; 48 scans came back positive (conception rate 0.85) and 10 failed. Confirmed does move BREEDING → PREGNANCY_EARLY at the scan, → PREGNANCY_LATE at gestation day 100, → DELIVERY 15 days before the expected kidding, kidd into RECOVERY on the due date and wean at day 60. 60 kids were born alive (0 stillborn).

### Leaving the herd: sales, culls, deaths

0 male kids were sold entering the 8–9 month meat window; 1 does were culled (2 failed services or age 72 months); 9 animals died (background mortality hazards converted from the operational phase rates: 15% kid loss across the 60-day pre-weaning window, 5% adult loss per year). The herd stands at 103 head on the final day, from 53 at the start.

### Same input, same farm

Every stochastic outcome (conception, litter size 1–4 with mean 1.6, kid sex, stillbirth, abortion, mortality) is drawn from one Random(20261002) stream in a fixed phase order over tags sorted alphabetically — re-running this input reproduces the ledger byte for byte.
